user.title: Scambio sul Posto estimate
user.description: Choose two yearly Utility Meter helpers for the same period. Financial assumptions are optional: leave unknown values empty. This is an estimate, not the official GSE settlement. The market zone is determined by the selected province.

error.invalid_energy: Choose an available Wh, kWh or MWh energy sensor.
error.invalid_province: Choose a province from the list.
error.annual_counters_required: Choose a yearly Utility Meter without tariffs or net consumption and with a valid current-year period.
error.counter_paused: The counter is paused. Resume collection before configuring the estimate.
error.periods_do_not_match: Both counters must cover the same period (five-minute tolerance).
